title: Annotedly fintech source list
description: Array of curated public regulatory, supervisory, and macro-financial feed entries for the fintech vertical.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, unique across the array.

url.description: Public URL of the feed (RSS/Atom) or landing/index page (http).

type.description: Feed transport. Use 'http' when the source has no public RSS/Atom and must be scraped or polled.

cadence.description: Five-field cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week).

vertical.description: Vertical tag. Always 'fintech' in this file.
